summary: Iteration 48: Cadet Photo Upload Feature Testing. All backend photo APIs (POST/GET/DELETE) pass 13/13 tests. Frontend shows avatars in roster table and By Flight view. Detail modal opens with larger avatar and camera icon for photo upload. Regression checks pass for Health Services and Financial Tracker pages.

html_hydration_warnings.issue: HTML nesting warnings (th/span, tr/span, td/span, tbody/span) in RosterPage table
html_hydration_warnings.note: These are React hydration warnings about invalid HTML nesting from Emergent's visual editor spans. They appear in console but don't affect functionality. Pre-existing from iteration 47.

critical_code_review_comments: Photo upload API correctly validates file types (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, HEIF) and size (5MB max)
GET photo endpoint supports both Authorization header and ?auth= query param for img src tags
CadetAvatar component properly handles both photo_path and initials fallback
Detail modal includes camera icon overlay for photo upload on hover
By Flight endpoint includes photo_path in response for avatar display

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All UI elements verified: avatars in table, By Flight view, detail modal with photo upload)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Photo upload feature fully implemented and tested. Backend uses Emergent Object Storage (REAL, not mocked). Photo endpoints: POST /api/participants/{id}/photo (multipart), GET /api/participants/{id}/photo?auth=TOKEN, DELETE /api/participants/{id}/photo. Frontend CadetAvatar component shows initials or actual photo. Detail modal has hover overlay with camera icon for upload.
